01 APPLIED ML · SG ANALYTICS

Better predictions.
Honest uncertainty.

Bayesian hierarchical models for enquiry-level predictions, connecting school, subregion, and global patterns.

PyMCBayesian modellingCalibration
Inside the project +

The question

How can related schools inform individual predictions while preserving local differences?

My approach

Built hierarchical classification models with posterior probabilities and highest-density intervals. Used calibration and feature reduction, including VIF, information value, mutual information, and PhiK.

The output

Enquiry-level probability estimates with uncertainty, supported by a structured hierarchy.

Professional project · SG Analytics

FROM DEMAND TO DECISIONS
Forecast & uncertainty · schematic
02 FORECASTING · SG ANALYTICS

The right people.
At the right time.

A call-centre planning pipeline connecting demand forecasts, queueing models, and workforce optimisation.

Prophet / ARIMAErlang-COR-Tools
Inside the project +

The question

How do forecast call volumes translate into staffing requirements and workable rosters?

My approach

Developed demand forecasting with Prophet and ARIMA, Poisson simulation, Erlang-C queueing, and roster optimisation using OR-Tools CP-SAT.

The output

Forecast demand, staffing estimates, rosters, and coverage views to assess service-level trade-offs.

Professional project · SG Analytics

03 AI SYSTEMS · SG ANALYTICS

From slide content
to a smarter workflow.

An enterprise presentation automation system that extracts content, plans changes, and regenerates slides.

PythonStreamlitLLM orchestration
Inside the project +

The question

How can repeated updates to business presentations become a structured, automatable workflow?

My contribution

Contributed to a system that extracts PowerPoint content into JSON, plans slide-level updates, and regenerates decks using Python, Streamlit, PowerPoint automation, and LLM/agent orchestration.

The output

A connected content-to-deck workflow for preparing client presentations.

04 / BEYOND THE MODELS

An engineer’s curiosity.
A researcher’s questions.

I enjoy connecting ideas across disciplines: statistics and engineering, language models and healthcare, research and everyday business decisions.

My foundation at BITS Pilani, Hyderabad, brought together engineering and a Data Science minor. Today, I work on applied data science at SG Analytics while continuing to explore reliable, useful AI.

The part I find most interesting is where a model meets the real world: uncertainty, constraints, and the people who need to understand the result.
